description:
The file '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/BFI25.csv' is already open in Jamovi. This dataset contains Big Five personality items (A1-O5) and demographic data. Your goal is to analyze the 'Agreeableness' trait.

1. Create a NEW Computed Variable named 'A1r' to reverse-code item A1 using the formula: 7 - A1
2. Create a NEW Computed Variable named 'Agreeableness' to calculate the scale mean using the formula: MEAN(A1r, A2, A3, A4, A5)
3. Run an Independent Samples T-Test comparing 'Agreeableness' (Dependent Variable) between genders ('gender' as Grouping Variable).
4. Enable 'Group Descriptives' to see the means.
5. Save the project as '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/BFI25_Agreeableness.omv'.
6. Create a text file at '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/agreeableness_results.txt' containing exactly these 4 lines:
   - Mean Agreeableness for Males (gender=1) (round to 3 decimals)
   - Mean Agreeableness for Females (gender=2) (round to 3 decimals)
   - The t-statistic (round to 3 decimals)
   - The p-value (round to 3 decimals, or '< .001')
